info.title: Google Groups Universal API
info.description: Manage Google Groups, memberships, aliases, and group settings in Google Workspace.

post.description: Adds a member to a group in Google Groups.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

groupKey.description: The group email address, group alias, or unique group ID.

email.description: The member's email address. This field is required when adding a member.

role.description: The member's role in the group, such as MEMBER, MANAGER, or OWNER.

deliverySettings.description: Email delivery preference for the member, such as ALL_MAIL, DAILY, DIGEST, DISABLED, or NONE.

get.description: Retrieves groups from Google Groups for a domain or user.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search expression for Google Groups.

schema.description: Search expression for Google Groups.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: Maximum number of groups to return per page.

schema.description: Maximum number of groups to return per page.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Field to sort by.

schema.description: Field to sort by.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort direction when orderBy is provided.

schema.description: Sort direction when orderBy is provided.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Limit results to a single domain instead of the full customer.

schema.description: Limit results to a single domain instead of the full customer.

parameters.name: userKey
parameters.description: List only groups that the specified user belongs to.

schema.description: List only groups that the specified user belongs to.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Token for the next page of results.

schema.description: Token for the next page of results.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

adminCreated.description: Whether the group was created by an administrator.

directMembersCount.description: Count of direct members returned by Google.

email.description: Primary email address of the group.

etag.description: Entity tag for the group resource.

kind.description: Google resource type for the group row.

nonEditableAliases.description: Aliases Google marks as non-editable for the group.
